---
title: "What do I find in the \"project investments\" table at first glance?"
description: ""
icon: "circle-help"
section: "portfolio"
sectionTitle: "Portfolio"
order: 11
---

**Projects:** This is the community project in which I have invested.

**Invested:** This is the amount I contributed to the project, at the exchange rate at the time of investment.

**Days:** This is the duration of the project (from funding to repayment). For projects In Progress, it is an estimate based on the expected repayment date.

**Effective Return:** This is the effective interest generated by the project, taking into account the difference between what was invested at the time of investment and what was recovered at loan repayment, without annualizing the result. In the farmer's local currency, this amount will increase as time passes since the project was funded.

**Return:** This is the amount I have recovered at the exchange rate on the day of the actual repayment. For loans in progress, it is the expected return at the end of the theoretical loan duration, assuming no default and at today's exchange rate.

**Current status:** This refers to the current stage of the loan in which I invested.
